channel.title: The Spread: Daily Oil & Gas Briefing
channel.description: A short daily briefing on oil and gas, refining, petrochemicals and midstream: Brent and WTI, LNG and European gas, refining margins, OPEC and shipping. What moved today, and why it matters. Every number is sourced, and claims are kept apart from facts. Built from free and official sources, written with AI, and read by an AI clone of Jaime's voice.
